logic.description: Tower of Vitality: tower of elem_vitality. Rule 2: the tile turns face up (open) once a unit attacks or moves towards it; effects lying there fire once as traps with 20 power per element. A character standing on it with stat_vitality ≥ 20, or adept in elem_vitality, gains +4 to that stat (yields.stat_bonus). Visiting one's tower also lifts the Love / Awe / Anger / Fear permanents (effects say "until they visit their tower"). In-contact units may attack or move onto it (Rule 7).

prerequisites.description: Rule 2: a unit in contact (distance ≤ 1) opens the tile by attacking or moving towards it.
To use the tower the character must stand on it (distance 0).
